notes: DeepFlux 8.3 - instant close, faster video open, background music, new defaults. Closing the app was a 1-2 second freeze; it is now immediate (about 0.1s) on every path. Opening a video from Explorer shows an Opening label and reaches the first frame faster, and the mini player pre-warms playback while idle. The Agent tab gains a looping background-music track (bundled, about 75 minutes) that starts with the app, can be toggled from the Agent tab or the mini player, and pauses whenever you play anything else - the setup grew to 485 MB because of it. The Matrix-style agent rain falls slower. Defaults refresh: Micro font, Dark Blue text, one download at a time (change any of it back in Settings). The second-instance open fix also covers custom control ports.
